description: Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, of memory and data in production. Top: three identical rounded boxes side by side 'Ask Rasoi replica 1', 'Ask Rasoi replica 2', 'Ask Rasoi replica 3', with a thin box above them 'Load balancer'. Below the replicas, two storage boxes side by side. Left storage: a sky-blue cylinder 'Redis' with three small lines inside 'session history, 7-day expiry', 'rate-limit counters', 'shared by every replica'. Right storage: a green-outlined cylinder 'Postgres with pgvector' with lines inside 'policy clauses and their vectors', 'who may read: a WHERE clause', 'HNSW index'. Every replica has thin arrows to both cylinders. Bottom: a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2', reached only through a box 'Toolbox over MCP'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Do not add any column headers, row headers, side labels, layer names or captions other than the labels listed here.

Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, a layered stack with a highlighted production band. Five layers numbered 1 to 5 on the far left, top to bottom: row 1 three rounded boxes 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'; row 2 a wide box 'Harness: the agent loop' containing 'LLM: the brain' and 'Knowledge: policy search and wiki' with a small circular arrow 'reason, act, observe' between; row 3 a thin bar 'MCP'; row 4 a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'; row 5 a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services'. Around the stack, a glowing sky-blue frame labelled at the top right 'Lecture 11: production', with five small sky-blue tags attached to the frame where they act: 'Guardrails' beside row 1 and row 2, 'Gateway: LiteLLM' beside row 2, 'Durable: Temporal' beside rows 2 to 4, 'Data: pgvector and Redis' beside row 2, 'Cost per order' at the bottom right. On the right, a narrow green column 'Trust: identity, approvals, guard, read-back, evals, traces' joined to the stack with dashed lines. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. The only text at the far left is the five numbers 1 to 5 in circles. Do not add any column headers, row headers, side labels, layer names or captions other than the labels listed here.

A comparison grid diagram, wide 16:9, of what managed agent platforms host. Leftmost column: six rounded boxes stacked top to bottom: a sky-blue box 'Your agent: code, prompts, tools' and below it five light grey boxes 'Runtime', 'Identity', 'Memory', 'Tool gateway', 'Observability'. Then four columns of small rounded cells, one cell per grey row, with these exact column titles and cells. Column 'AWS Bedrock AgentCore': 'AgentCore Runtime', 'AgentCore Identity', 'AgentCore Memory', 'AgentCore Gateway', 'AgentCore Observability'. Column 'Microsoft Foundry': 'Foundry Agent Service', 'Entra Agent ID', 'Foundry memory', 'Foundry tools and MCP', 'Foundry tracing'. Column 'Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform': 'Agent Runtime', 'Agent Identity', 'Sessions and Memory Bank', 'Agent Gateway', 'Agent Observability'. Column 'Ask Rasoi, built by hand', with cells in soft sky blue: 'Modal app', 'passthrough Bahi session', 'Redis and pgvector', 'MCP toolbox and LiteLLM', 'traces and eval suite'. Thin light grey horizontal lines join each row across the columns. The first three columns' cells are white with grey outlines.
